entries.source: Killed the Orc Greatmother in the breeding pits, thus dealing a terrible blow to the orc race.
entries.target: 在兽人育种棚中杀死巨型兽人母体，给兽人一族带来了沉重打击。

entries.source: Both killed your future self and got killed by your future self.
entries.target: 既杀死过未来的自己，也曾被未来的自己杀死。

entries.source: Killed the weaver queen and the temporal defiler.
entries.target: 杀死织网蛛后和时空污秽魔。

entries.source: Finished the whole Abashed Expanse zone without being hit by a single void blast or manaworm. Dodging's fun!
entries.target: 通关整个次元浮岛，全程未被任何一次虚空爆炸或法力蠕虫命中。闪避真有趣！

entries.source: Destroyed the naga portal in the slazish fens and got caught in the after-effect.
entries.target: 在斯拉伊什沼泽摧毁娜迦传送门，并被卷入了它的余波。

entries.source: Pyromancer
entries.target: 烈焰术士

entries.source: Unlocked Archmage class and did over one million fire damage (with any item/talent/class).
entries.target: 解锁元素法师职业并造成超过100万火焰伤害（使用任意物品/技能/职业）。

entries.source: Cryomancer
entries.target: 冰霜术士

entries.source: Unlocked Archmage class and did over one million cold damage (with any item/talent/class).
entries.target: 解锁元素法师职业并造成超过100万寒冷伤害（使用任意物品/技能/职业）。

entries.source: Lichform
entries.target: 巫妖转生

entries.source: Achieved your wild dreams of power and eternal life: you turned into a Lich!
entries.target: 成就你的野心并获得永恒的生命，你终于成为了巫妖！

entries.source: Best album ever!
entries.target: 最佳唱片

entries.source: Removed 89 beneficial effects from enemies via Disintegration.
entries.target: 使用裂解清除敌人身上的89个增益效果。

entries.source: Adventurer
entries.target: 冒险家

entries.source: Adventurers can learn to do a bit of everything, getting training in whatever they happen to find.
entries.target: 冒险家样样都能学一点，碰巧遇到什么技能就学什么。

entries.source: Wanderer
entries.target: 流浪者

entries.source: Wanderers are adventurers who embrace the chaotic nature of the world. They start the game with the Combat Training talent tree, 3 random class trees and 1 random generic tree.
entries.target: 流浪者是拥抱世界混乱本质的冒险家。进入游戏时，他们初始拥有战斗训练系，3个随机职业技能系以及1个随机通用技能系。

entries.source: #{bold}##PURPLE#Every 5 levels they gain a new unlocked class tree, at random.#{normal}##LAST#
entries.target: #{bold}##PURPLE#每升5级，获得一系解锁的随机职业技能树。#{normal}##LAST#

entries.source: #{bold}##PURPLE#Every 10 levels starting at level 2 they gain a new unlocked generic tree, at random.#{normal}##LAST#
entries.target: #{bold}##PURPLE#从2级开始，每升10级获得一系解锁的随机通用技能树。#{normal}##LAST#

entries.source: #{bold}##GOLD#This is a bonus class for the chaotically inclined. It is by no means balanced, fun or winnable, it is most of all #{italic}#RANDOM#{bold}#.#WHITE##{normal}#
entries.target: #{bold}##GOLD#这是为倾向混乱者准备的奖励职业。它绝不平衡，也不保证有趣或能通关；最重要的是，它完全#{italic}#随机#{bold}#。#WHITE##{normal}#

entries.source: Their most important stats depend on what they get to do.
entries.target: 他们的随机技能决定了他们的主属性。

entries.source: Afflicted
entries.target: 痛苦系

entries.source: Some walk in shadow, alone, unloved, unwanted. What powers they wield may be mighty, but their names are forever cursed.
entries.target: 他们是一群漫步于阴影中、孤独的、讨人厌的、被遗弃的人。他们的力量或许很强大，但他们的名字永远被诅咒着。

entries.source: Afflicted classes have been twisted by their association with evil forces.
entries.target: 痛苦系因为他们使用了邪恶的力量而变得扭曲。

entries.source: They can use these forces to their advantage, but at a cost...
entries.target: 他们能将这股力量转化为优势，但会为此付出一定的代价……

entries.source: Cursed
entries.target: 被诅咒者

entries.source: Affliction can run to the soul, and hatred can fill one's entire being. Overcome someone else's hated curse to know its dreaded meaning.
entries.target: 诅咒可以深入灵魂，使某人充满憎恨。战胜另外一个人的憎恨诅咒来领会这种可怕的力量。

entries.source: Through ignorance, greed or folly the Cursed served some dark design and are now doomed to pay for their sins.
entries.target: 被诅咒者曾经因为无知、贪婪或者愚昧，服从于黑暗的指示。现在，他们因罪恶而身受灾难折磨。

entries.source: Their only master now is the hatred they carry for every living thing.
entries.target: 他们现在唯一的主人，是他们心中对一切生灵怀有的憎恨。

entries.source: Drawing strength from the death of all they encounter, the Cursed become terrifying combatants.
entries.target: 他们从所遇一切生灵的死亡中汲取力量，成为恐怖的战士。

entries.source: Worse, any who approach the Cursed can be driven mad by their terrible aura.
entries.target: 更可怕的是，任何接近被诅咒者的人，会受可怕光环的影响而发狂。

entries.source: Their most important stats are: Strength and Willpower
entries.target: 他们最重要的属性是：力量和意志。

entries.target: #GOLD#属性修正：

entries.source: Doomed
entries.target: 末日使者

entries.source: In shaded places in unknown lands thou must overcome thyself and see thy doom.
entries.target: 在未知之地的阴影之中，你必须战胜自己，直面自己的末日。

entries.source: The Doomed are fallen mages who once wielded powerful magic wrought by ambition and dark bargains.
entries.target: 末日使者是一些堕落的法师，他们曾经由于野心，通过黑暗的契约，获得了强大的魔法。

entries.source: Stripped of their magic by the dark forces that once served them, they have learned to harness the hatred that burns in their minds.
entries.target: 曾经侍奉他们的黑暗力量夺去了他们的魔法，他们由此学会了驾驭心头燃烧的憎恨。

entries.source: Only time will tell if they can choose a new path or are doomed forever.
entries.target: 只有时间会证明他们能否选择一条新的道路，还是永远为厄运所缚。

entries.source: The Doomed strike from behind a veil of darkness or a host of shadows.
entries.target: 末日使者从黑暗帷幕或阴影群的掩护下发动攻击。

entries.source: They feed upon their enemies as they unleash their minds on all who confront them.
entries.target: 他们以敌人为食，并对所有与他们对峙的人释放精神冲击。

entries.source: Their most important stats are: Willpower and Cunning
entries.target: 他们最重要的属性是：意志和灵巧。

entries.target: #LIGHT_BLUE# * +0 魔力，+4 意志，+5 灵巧

entries.source: Celestial
entries.target: 天空系

entries.source: The magic of the heavens is known to but a few, and that knowledge has long passed east, forgotten.
entries.target: 天空魔法鲜有人知，而那些知识早已东传，被人遗忘。

entries.source: Celestial classes are arcane users focused on the heavenly bodies.
entries.target: 天空系职业是使用天体能量的奥术使用者。

entries.source: Most draw their powers from the Sun and the Moons.
entries.target: 大部分都是从太阳和月亮汲取能量。

entries.source: Sun Paladin
entries.target: 太阳骑士

entries.source: The sun rises in the east in full glory, but you must look for it first amidst the darkest places.
entries.target: 东方升起的太阳充满荣耀，但你首先得从黑暗之地寻找到它。

entries.source: Sun Paladins hail from the Gates of Morning, the last bastion of the free people in the Far East.
entries.target: 太阳骑士出生于晨曦之门，那是遥远东方自由生活的人们的最后堡垒。

entries.source: Their way of life is well represented by their motto 'The Sun is our giver, our purity, our essence. We carry the light into dark places, and against our strength none shall pass.'
entries.target: 他们的生活方式集中体现在他们的座右铭中：太阳是我们的赐予者、我们的纯洁、我们的本质。我们为黑暗带去光明，在我们的力量面前，谁也休想通过。

entries.source: They can channel the power of the Sun to smite all who seek to destroy the Sunwall.
entries.target: 他们能施展太阳之力将任何试图破坏太阳堡垒的力量击退。

entries.source: Competent in both weapon and shield combat and magic, they usually burn their foes from afar before bashing them in melee.
entries.target: 他们既擅长武器与盾牌格斗，也通晓魔法，通常先从远处灼烧敌人，再近身猛击。

entries.source: Their most important stats are: Strength and Magic
entries.target: 他们最重要的属性是：力量和魔力。

entries.target: #GOLD#属性修正：

entries.target: #GOLD#每等级生命加值：#LIGHT_BLUE# +2

entries.source: Anorithil
entries.target: 星月术士

entries.source: The balance of the heavens' powers is a daunting task. Mighty are those that stand in the twilight places, wielding both light and darkness in their mind.
entries.target: 平衡天空的力量是一件令人望而生畏的任务。强大的是那些驻足于暮光之境的人，心中同时驾驭着光明与黑暗的力量。

entries.source: Anorithils hail from the Gates of Morning, the last bastion of the free people in the Far East.
entries.target: 星月术士出生于晨曦之门，那是遥远东方自由生活的人们的最后堡垒。

entries.source: Their way of life is well represented by their motto 'We stand betwixt the Sun and Moon, where light and darkness meet. In the grey twilight we seek our destiny.'
entries.target: 他们的生活方式集中体现在其座右铭中：“我们站在太阳与月亮之间，光暗交替之界。我们在灰色的暮光中寻找命运。”

entries.source: They can channel the power of the Sun and the Moons to burn and tear apart all who seek to destroy the Sunwall.
entries.target: 他们可以施展太阳、月亮的法术将任何试图破坏太阳堡垒的人消灭。

entries.source: Masters of Sun and Moon magic, they usually burn their foes with Sun rays before calling the fury of the stars.
entries.target: 他们掌握日月魔法，可以使用灼热的太阳射线和群星的愤怒毁灭对手。

entries.source: Their most important stats are: Magic and Cunning
entries.target: 他们最重要的属性是：魔力和灵巧。
